issues_detected.description: Version numbering regresses across releases. version is '2.0' for the June 2026 release, but version_access.versions_available states the June 2025 and October 2025 releases were 'at version 2.1'. A later release carrying a lower version string than its two predecessors violates monotonic version ordering and will mislead any consumer resolving 'latest' by version string.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the release version sequence: either correct the prior-release version numbers recorded in version_access.versions_available, or advance this release past 2.1, and state which numbering authority (Dataverse V-number vs. CM4AI release version) the version slot reports.

issues_detected.description: No software is named that produced or transformed the data actually distributed in this release. The named tooling (node2vec, DenseNet-121, GPT-4/GSAI, HiDeF, cellmaps_pipeline) is the MuSIC cell-map pipeline, and known_limitations states 'This is an interim release. It does not contain predicted cell maps'. preprocessing_strategies further describes those steps as consuming 'downloaded' networks and images, i.e. downstream of this release. No mass-spectrometry search or quantitation software is named for the AP-MS/SEC-MS archives, and no single-cell processing software is named for the Perturb-seq atlas packaged as processed_data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the software and versions that produced each distributed product: the MS search/quantitation stack behind cm4ai_mass-spec_* and cm4ai_apms_*, the single-cell pipeline behind cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas, and any image-processing applied to the ICC-IF archives.

issues_detected.description: The variables slot is absent entirely; no data dictionary or variable-level metadata is given for any modality. is_tabular is explicitly false, which fits the imaging archives, but the SEC-MS elution profiles and the Perturb-seq cell atlas distributed as processed_data are inherently columnar and carry no field definitions.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variables entries with identifiers and descriptions for the tabular products (SEC-MS fraction/intensity columns, Perturb-seq atlas phenotype and guide-assignment fields), even if the imaging archives remain non-tabular.

issues_detected.description: Payload formats inside the distributed ZIP archives are unstated. distribution_formats declares only 'ZIP Archive' (application/zip) and 'RO-Crate'; no scientific format (e.g. mzML, FASTQ, TIFF/OME-TIFF, h5ad) and no character encoding are given, so a reuser cannot determine what will be found after decompression.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare per-collection payload formats and media types alongside the ZIP container, and state character encoding for text-based tabular products.

issues_detected.description: No change descriptions or errata are provided for this release. errata is absent, and updates.update_details carries only a forward-looking cadence statement ('regularly updated and augmented through the end of the project in November 2026, with updates on a quarterly basis') rather than what changed relative to the October 2025 (v2.1) release that this record supersedes.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add per-release change notes stating which data products were added, revised, or released from embargo since the October 2025 release, and record any errata against prior releases.

issues_detected.description: The de-identification claim is asserted without assessing residual genomic re-identification risk. is_deidentified states the data 'cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject', yet the release distributes CRISPRi Perturb-seq raw sequence data from the donor-derived KOLF2.1J line (cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip) and deposits raw sequence in SRA; sampling_strategies discloses donor attributes ('healthy male Northern European donor'; '51-year-old black female'). Genotype-bearing sequence from an identified cell line is the standard locus of residual risk and is not discussed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add an explicit residual re-identification risk statement for the genome-scale sequence products, referencing the consent and distribution terms under which the KOLF2.1J (HipSci) and MDA-MB-468 (ATCC) lines permit genotype-bearing data release.

issues_detected.description: Update horizon extends past the stated funding period. funders records a project period of 2022-09-01 to 2026-08-31, while updates.update_details commits to quarterly updates 'through the end of the project in November 2026'.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the project end date, or note the no-cost extension or successor award that supports maintenance beyond 2026-08-31.

issues_detected.description: The anomalies and missing_data_documentation slots are both absent. cleaning_strategies notes only that single-cell CRISPR QC was 'reported as undergoing quality control at the time of the CM4AI preprint', leaving the QC outcome, failure modes, and any excluded or missing measurements undocumented for released data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record QC outcomes, known anomalies (failed antibodies, low-confidence guide assignments, dropped fractions), and missing-data patterns per modality.

issues_detected.description: imputation_protocols is absent with no statement that imputation was not performed, and annotation_analyses is absent despite a described LLM naming step that emits confidence scores.
issues_detected.recommendation: State explicitly that no imputation was applied, and record annotation quality analyses including the distribution of GSAI name-confidence scores.

issues_detected.description: No download_url slot is populated. Access is nonetheless actionable via distribution_formats.access_urls (the Dataverse persistent-ID landing page) with a stated Data Access API and per-file paths with MD5 checksums, so this is a slot-placement gap rather than an access gap.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate download_url with the Dataverse Data Access API endpoint for the persistent identifier so machine clients need not parse distribution_formats.

issues_detected.description: known_biases records only representation_bias. The deliberate protein-level selection disclosed in sampling_strategies ('targeting 100 chromatin modifiers and 100 metabolic enzymes') and the incomplete cross-modality protein overlap noted in known_limitations are selection/coverage biases that are described elsewhere but not categorized in the bias taxonomy.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a selection_bias entry covering targeted protein-set selection and the non-overlapping protein coverage across SEC-MS, ICC-IF, and Perturb-seq modalities.

issues_detected.description: publisher is a bare ROR identifier (ROR:0153tk833, University of Virginia) naming the institution rather than the repository. Repository identity is recoverable from citation ('University of Virginia Dataverse') and distribution_formats.access_urls (dataverse.lib.virginia.edu), so the platform is determinable but not directly asserted in the publisher slot.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the repository (University of Virginia Dataverse) in the publisher slot alongside the institutional ROR.

semantic_insights: DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C is well-formed and its prefix is internally corroborated three ways: publisher ROR:0153tk833 resolves to the University of Virginia, citation names 'University of Virginia Dataverse', and distribution_formats.access_urls points at dataverse.lib.virginia.edu.

Both NIH awards validate against NIH grant syntax and are institute-appropriate: 1OT2OD032742-01 (activity OT2, Office of the Director, the Bridge2AI data generation mechanism) and 5U54HG012513-02 (activity U54, NHGRI, correct institute for the Bridge2AI Bridge Center).

Applicability: the human-subjects condition fails on external evidence rather than on Element 4's own silence. The E1 description is entirely cell-line based (MDA-MB-468, KOLF2.1J iPSCs and derivatives) and E8 collection_mechanisms describe instrument assays (SEC-MS, AP-MS, ICC-IF, CRISPRi screens) with no participant recruitment. Element 4 sub-elements 3-5 are therefore not applicable.

Applicability: the governance condition is met, so Element 4 sub-elements 1-2 remain applicable and are scored. regulatory_restrictions.governance_committee_contact names Jillian Parker, and data_governance declares the CM4AI Data Access Committee with an access_review_process supervising distribution and dual licensing over donor-derived material.

Explicit negative flags are used as substantive documentation rather than omission: confidential_elements_present, sensitive_elements_present, content_warnings_present and identifiable_elements_present are all false and each carries a reasoned justification tied to the tissue-culture provenance.

Cross-field numeric consistency holds throughout: 464 proteins per condition appears identically in instances, subpopulations.distribution and the three ICC-IF file_collections entries; 11,739 targeted genes appears identically in instances, sampling_strategies and the Perturb-seq collection description.

Licensing is coherent across four slots: license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, license_and_use_terms.data_use_permission no_commercial_use, prohibited_uses barring commercial use, and ip_restrictions naming the specific copyright holders (Regents of UC; Stanford for spatial proteomics raw imagery) whose consent commercial licensing requires.

The ip_restrictions attribution of spatial proteomics raw image copyright to Stanford is corroborated by data_collectors and collection_mechanisms placing ICC-IF imaging in the Lundberg Lab at Stanford, an unusually well-joined provenance-to-rights linkage.

hipaa_compliant: not_applicable is the semantically correct value here rather than a gap, since no human-subject or clinical data is present; it is consistent with human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false and direct_collection.is_direct: false.

source_caveats demonstrate unusual provenance discipline: project-level aggregates (53,788 images, 7,023 proteins, 1,374 interactions) are explicitly withheld from release-level slots, a conflicting 563-vs-464 protein count is adjudicated to the higher-ranked source, and a creator affiliation conflict is recorded rather than silently resolved.

known_limitations are typed (scope, coverage, integration, methodological) and one carries a recommended_mitigation, and the embargo it describes is consistent with the restriction recorded on the corresponding external_resources entry.

Standards conformance is layered and machine-actionable: RO-Crate packaging via FAIRSCAPE, conforms_to_schema pointing at the Bridge2AI data-sheets-schema w3id URI, plus ORCID, ROR, RRID (CVCL_0419, CVCL_B5P3) and B2AI topic/substrate ontology terms.

RRIDs are well-formed. Format valid and prefix plausible.

Description far exceeds 200 characters and is non-boilerplate: it states modalities, cell lines, treatment arms, the AI-readiness objective, RO-Crate/FAIRSCAPE packaging, programme structure, and the nine collaborating institutions.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Description content is semantically consistent with the modalities in acquisition_methods and with the ten entries in file_collections; the release-scoped 'This Beta release includes...' sentence matches the per-modality coverage recorded in subpopulations.distribution.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: Every keyword is corroborated by record content; no keyword stuffing or unsupported claim. 'Bridge2AI' and 'CM4AI' supply the programme context consistent with publisher and funders.

sub_elements.evidence: page: https://cm4ai.org/data-releases/; distribution_formats.access_urls: https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C; file_collections lists 10 named resources with paths, sizes and MD5 checksums
sub_elements.quality_note: Two complementary landing pages (project release index and repository record) plus a ten-entry resource inventory giving per-file collection_type, path, compression, size and checksum.

sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: 6 entries with relationship_type is_new_version_of (doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM, F3TD5R, B35XWX, DXWOS5), is_described_by (doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311), is_referenced_by (doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734); subsets: 7 entries with hierarchical ids of the form doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C#subset-...

elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms.license_terms: full CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 conditions; data_use_permission: no_commercial_use; contact_person: Trey Ideker. ip_restrictions: 'Copyright is held by the Regents of the University of California except where otherwise noted; spatial proteomics raw image data is copyright the Board of Trustees of the Leland Stanford Junior University.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Access policy is stated at the level a reuser can act on: the four CC BY-NC-SA obligations are spelled out, the commercial carve-out names which institution to approach per data package, and a named contact with an ORCID is given.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Consistent across four slots: license, license_and_use_terms.data_use_permission, prohibited_uses (commercial prohibition), and ip_restrictions (commercial negotiation requirement). The Stanford copyright carve-out correctly tracks data_collectors, which places ICC-IF imaging in the Lundberg Lab at Stanford.

sub_elements.name: Regulatory Compliance and Confidentiality Classification
sub_elements.evidence: regulatory_restrictions: 'The release records FDA Regulated: No'; hipaa_compliant: not_applicable; governance_committee_contact: Jillian Parker (ORCID:0000-0003-4535-3486). data_governance.committee_name: CM4AI Data Access Committee; access_review_process: 'A Data Access Committee supervises ethical matters related to dataset distribution and potential dual licensing for commercial use.' confidential_elements_present: false with justification.
sub_elements.quality_note: Regulatory status is explicitly classified rather than left silent, and the governance limb of this sub-element's scope is strongly served: a named committee, a named contact with ORCID and institutional email, a described review remit, and stewardship_roles.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: hipaa_compliant: not_applicable is the semantically correct value given human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false and non-clinical tissue-culture provenance; asserting compliance instead would have been an inconsistency. No confidentiality_level enum value and no other_compliance entries, which limits machine classification but does not negate the substantive governance documentation.

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats.access_urls: https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C with notes 'Individual files below the download size limit may be downloaded directly; the Data Access API is available for programmatic access'; file_collections give per-file paths and MD5 checksums; page: https://cm4ai.org/data-releases/
sub_elements.quality_note: Scored on the sub-element's stated scope, which accepts platform access instructions as well as direct links. A reuser is told where the data lives, that large files require the API rather than browser download, the exact filenames, and the checksums to verify them.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: The dedicated download_url slot is unpopulated, recorded as a low-severity slot-placement issue rather than an access gap. The access URL is well-formed and embeds the declared persistent identifier; the size caveat is consistent with file_collections listing 3.8-4.6 GB imaging archives.

sub_elements.name: Distribution Formats and File Types Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: format 'ZIP Archive' with media_type 'application/zip', and format 'RO-Crate' with note on FAIRSCAPE packaging; file_collections entries each carry compression: zip and collection_type (raw_data, processed_data, metadata)
sub_elements.quality_note: Container format and MIME type are both declared, and each of the ten collections is typed by content role, which tells a reuser which archives are raw versus processed versus metadata.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: media_type application/zip correctly corresponds to the declared ZIP format. Recorded as a medium-severity completeness issue: the scientific payload formats inside the archives and character encoding are not declared, so the format declaration stops at the container.

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets and External Resources Linked
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: 6 typed entries with target DOIs. external_resources: 11 entries including MassIVE depositions for iPSC and cancer-cell SEC-MS and for both AP-MS conditions, SRA via NCBI BioProject, Figshare CRISPRi atlas, https://cm4ai.org, https://github.com/idekerlab/cellmaps_pipeline, https://cellmaps-pipeline.readthedocs.io/, https://fairscape.github.io, http://integrativemodeling.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Exceptionally rich linkage across archival repositories, code, documentation and publications. Six external_resources entries carry archival: true, and the embargoed Perturb-seq entry carries an explicit restriction rather than being omitted.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: The embargo restriction is consistent with known_limitations (integration_limitation) and third_party_sharing, which independently record the pre-publication embargo. Repository choices are domain-appropriate: MassIVE for mass spectrometry, SRA for sequence.

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met: distribution_formats populated with access_urls to the UVA Dataverse record, file_collections lists 10 published files with sizes and checksums, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license explicitly permits share and adapt.
sub_elements.evidence: license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; license_and_use_terms.license_terms: 'Users are free to share and adapt the material, provided appropriate credit is given, a link to the license is provided, changes are indicated, the material is not used for commercial purposes, and contributions are distributed under the same license.'
sub_elements.quality_note: A named, standard, machine-recognizable license with its permissions and four obligations stated in full, plus an explicit route (separate negotiation with the copyright holder) for uses the license excludes.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: License identity is consistent across license, license_and_use_terms, data_use_permission and prohibited_uses. The NC restriction is a genuine reuse constraint but does not negate reuse permission.

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized (encoding, format)
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, access_urls, published file_collections, reuse-permitting license).
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: 'ZIP Archive' (application/zip) and 'RO-Crate'; conforms_to: RO-Crate; conforms_to_standard: [RO_CRATE]; description: 'Output data are packaged with provenance graphs and rich metadata as AI-ready datasets in RO-Crate format using the FAIRSCAPE framework'
sub_elements.quality_note: Scored on the RO-Crate limb rather than the ZIP limb. ZIP alone would be trivial, but RO-Crate is a genuine community packaging standard carrying JSON-LD metadata and provenance graphs, and it is asserted consistently in three slots plus a dedicated metadata archive in file_collections.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: RO-Crate conformance is verifiable and semantically appropriate for a multi-modal AI-ready release. Recorded as a medium-severity issue: no payload formats (mzML, FASTQ, TIFF, h5ad) and no encoding are declared, so harmonization below the package level is not supported by this record.

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, access_urls, published file_collections, reuse-permitting license).
sub_elements.evidence: conforms_to: RO-Crate; conforms_to_standard: [RO_CRATE]; conforms_to_schema: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema; conforms_to_class: Dataset; instances carry data_substrate: B2AI_SUBSTRATE:19 / :63 and data_topic: B2AI_TOPIC:15 / :26 / :12
sub_elements.quality_note: Conformance is stated at three distinct levels (packaging standard, metadata schema by resolvable w3id URI, and schema class) and is reinforced by actual use of controlled ontology terms on instances and of ORCID, ROR and RRID identifier schemes throughout.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: The w3id.org URI is a well-formed persistent schema identifier. labeling_strategies further reference Gene Ontology and Reactome alignment, which are recognized biological ontologies appropriate to the data type.

sub_elements.name: Variable Metadata with Identifiers Defined
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, access_urls, published file_collections, reuse-permitting license). Applicability rests on external distribution evidence, not on the absence of the variables slot.
sub_elements.evidence: No variables slot is present anywhere in the record. is_tabular: false. The nearest content is instances[0].notes describing the four image channels and file_collections descriptions.
sub_elements.quality_note: Fails: no variable-level metadata with identifiers and descriptions is provided for any distributed product. The imaging channel description is useful but is prose within an instance note, not defined variables with identifiers.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: is_tabular: false partially explains the omission for the imaging archives, but cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip and the SEC-MS archives are distributed as processed_data with inherently columnar content and receive no field definitions, so the omission is not fully justified by data type.

sub_elements.name: Use Guidance Provided (intended, prohibited uses)
sub_elements.evidence: intended_uses: 5 entries each with use_category and usage_notes (AI-ready research data, AI model training, cellular process analysis, perturbation and disease-context analysis, bioinformatics analysis of component datasets). prohibited_uses: clinical decision-making without regulatory oversight; commercial use. discouraged_uses: use without domain expertise; use as a complete cell-map resource.
sub_elements.quality_note: All three limbs populated with reasoned, specific guidance. The discouraged_uses entries are notably candid, steering users away from treating an interim release as a finished cell-map resource.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Guidance is internally consistent: the 'complete cell-map resource' discouragement matches known_limitations scope_limitation, and the commercial prohibition matches the NC license and ip_restrictions. The clinical-use prohibition is semantically appropriate for non-clinical in vitro data.

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review and Data Protection Impact
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Governance disjunct satisfied on Element 2 evidence: regulatory_restrictions.governance_committee_contact names Jillian Parker, and data_governance declares the CM4AI Data Access Committee with access_review_process 'supervises ethical matters related to dataset distribution and potential dual licensing for commercial use' - a governance constraint that applies, not a record that none applies. Donor-derived cell-line material is under that oversight. The human-subjects disjunct fails (see sub-elements 3-5), but either disjunct opens this sub-element.
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: two entries. First describes the Ethics Module's 'plan for ethical preparation, licensing, dissemination, and Data Access supervision of CM4AI datasets, balancing openness of the data produced with protection of intellectual property', contact_person Vardit Ravitsky (ORCID:0000-0002-7080-8801), email ravitskyv@thehastingscenter.org. Second names Jean-Christophe Belisle-Pipon (ORCID:0000-0002-8965-8153), Simon Fraser University. human_subject_research.notes records ethical sourcing: MDA-MB-468 from ATCC, KOLF2.1J from HipSci 'available for access by not-for-profit organizations via a simple MTA'.
sub_elements.quality_note: Substantive and actionable: a standing ethics body with a described remit, two named reviewers with ORCIDs and reachable emails, a data access committee, and documented ethical provenance of both cell lines including the MTA route for the iPSC line.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: No IRB approval number and no data_protection_impacts entry, both semantically appropriate here rather than gaps, since involves_human_subjects is false and E1/E8 independently confirm no participants. The consistency rule requiring IRB detail applies only when involves_human_subjects is true, and is not triggered.

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Same governance disjunct as sub-element 1: regulatory_restrictions.governance_committee_contact and the data_governance Data Access Committee state an applicable governance constraint over donor-derived material, which the instrument identifies as a case where deidentification can apply without human participants.
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false; deidentification_details: 'The release records De-identified Samples: Yes. CM4AI data are distinctive within Bridge2AI in that they are non-clinical (from tissue cultures) and are considered to be de-identified as they cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject.' direct_collection.collection_details: 'All data were generated in vitro from commercially available, de-identified human cell lines: MDA-MB-468 (RRID:CVCL_0419), available from ATCC, and KOLF2.1J (RRID:CVCL_B5P3), available from the Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Initiative (HipSci) resource.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Scored 1 on type-appropriateness. No formal standard is named, but for immortalized cell lines the substantive answer is the upstream sourcing basis, and that is given precisely: both lines identified by RRID, both sourced already de-identified from named repositories (ATCC, HipSci), with the non-clinical tissue-culture rationale stated.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Demanding HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination would be a category error for in vitro cell-line data with no covered-entity origin. Consistent with confidential_elements_present: false, sensitive_elements_present: false and hipaa_compliant: not_applicable. Flagged as a medium-severity content_accuracy issue: residual genomic re-identification risk from distributed raw CRISPRi sequence is not assessed despite donor attributes being disclosed in sampling_strategies.source_data.

sub_elements.name: Privacy Protections and Re-identification Risk Assessment
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition fails on external evidence. E1 description covers only MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells and KOLF2.1J iPSCs and their derivatives; E1 keywords name cell lines, assays and drugs with no participant, patient or clinical-research term. E8 collection_mechanisms describe SEC-MS, AP-MS, ICC-IF microscopy and CRISPRi screens - instrument assays, not participant recruitment. Per the instrument, the governance structure present in E2 is not a participant signal and does not reach this sub-element.
sub_elements.evidence: No participant privacy documentation exists because there are no participants: participant_privacy and reidentification_risk are absent, and direct_collection.is_direct: false records 'Data were not collected from human subjects.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Excluded from the denominator. Scoring 0 here would measure the dataset's subject matter rather than its documentation quality, since there is no participant population whose privacy could be protected.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition fails on the same external E1/E8 evidence: a cell-line-only description and keyword set, and collection mechanisms describing laboratory assays rather than recruitment. The E2 governance structure is not a participant signal.
sub_elements.evidence: informed_consent is absent. human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false; the ethical route for the source material is instead documented as repository sourcing under MTA in human_subject_research.notes.
sub_elements.quality_note: Excluded from the denominator. There are no participants from whom consent could be obtained; the upstream donor consent governing the ATCC and HipSci lines is the source repositories' responsibility and is gestured at via the MTA note.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition fails on the same external E1/E8 evidence. No participant population exists, so there is no at-risk population to protect and no one to compensate. The E2 governance structure is not a participant signal.
sub_elements.evidence: at_risk_populations and participant_compensation are absent, consistent with human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false and direct_collection.is_direct: false.

sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations.subpopulation_elements_present: true with identification enumerating all seven cell-type/treatment conditions and distribution stating per-modality coverage. subsets: 7 entries, each with id, name, description and is_subpopulation: true (MDA-MB-468 untreated/paclitaxel/vorinostat; KOLF2.1J undifferentiated, NPC, neuron, cardiomyocyte).

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Per #1081 this sub-element is not gated on a repository pointer. Element 8's datasets-shared condition is met (distribution_formats, Dataverse access_urls, 10 published file_collections), and the dataset was processed - preprocessing_strategies, cleaning_strategies and two collections typed collection_type: processed_data establish this - so the question of what software produced the distributed data is live and is scored.

Against this, known_limitations states: 'This is an interim release. It does not contain predicted cell maps, which will be added in future releases.' preprocessing_strategies describes its inputs as 'Downloaded protein-protein interaction networks' and images 'downloaded from the Lundberg Laboratory's deposition archive'.
sub_elements.quality_note: Fails on the #1059/#1082 threshold: no software is named that produced or transformed the data actually being distributed. Every named tool falls into an excluded role. (e) node2vec, DenseNet-121, GPT-4/GSAI, HiDeF and cellmaps_pipeline constitute the MuSIC cell-map pipeline, and the record itself states its outputs - the predicted cell maps - are not in this release; preprocessing_strategies confirms these steps consume already-deposited data as input, placing them downstream of the release. (c) FAIRSCAPE produced the RO-Crate provenance metadata packaging the release without transforming the data inside it. (a) the 10x Genomics 3'HT kit is acquisition instrumentation. The Integrative Modeling Platform is a downstream modeling tool for a future task.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: RO-Crate is a recognized community packaging standard and the claim is backed by an actual cm4ai_release_metadata.zip containing RO-Crate metadata and provenance graphs. The w3id.org schema URI is a well-formed persistent identifier.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, Dataverse access_urls, published file_collections, reuse-permitting license).
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://cm4ai.org/data-releases/. external_resources: 'CM4AI project web portal at https://cm4ai.org, providing documentation, data releases, tools, publications, and training materials'; https://cellmaps-pipeline.readthedocs.io/; FAIRSCAPE 'described with a tutorial and installation instructions at https://fairscape.github.io'. existing_uses: 'hands-on training at a virtual CodeFest held in March 2024, attended by 38 registrants... accompanied by detailed tutorials explaining how the data were derived and integrated and providing production-ready software for producing the datasets.' other_tasks describes asynchronous virtual training, hosted virtual events, and an in-person internship co-hosted at Yale and UCSD.
sub_elements.quality_note: Outreach is documented as delivered activity with attendance figures, not merely as intent, and is backed by concrete documentation links spanning a project portal, API documentation and an installation tutorial.

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets with Typed Relationships
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, Dataverse access_urls, published file_collections, reuse-permitting license).
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: six entries each carrying an explicit relationship_type and a resolvable target - is_new_version_of to doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM (October 2025), doi:10.18130/V3/F3TD5R (June 2025), doi:10.18130/V3/B35XWX (March 2025), doi:10.18130/V3/DXWOS5 (May 2024); is_described_by to doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311; is_referenced_by to doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734.
sub_elements.quality_note: Relationships use standard typed vocabulary, every target carries a DOI and a human-readable name, and the set spans both version lineage and literature linkage rather than one or the other.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Relationship semantics are used correctly: is_described_by points to the CM4AI preprint describing the resource, is_referenced_by to a Perturbation Cell Atlas paper citing it, and the four is_new_version_of targets match version_access.versions_available one-to-one. The 10.18130 targets share this record's registrant prefix, as expected for prior releases in the same repository.

strengths: Exceptional cross-field numeric and semantic consistency: the 464-proteins-per-condition and 11,739-targeted-genes figures agree across instances, subpopulations and file_collections, and the licensing chain is coherent across license, data_use_permission, prohibited_uses and ip_restrictions down to which institution holds copyright in which data package.

Unusually disciplined provenance hygiene in source_caveats: project-level aggregates are explicitly withheld from release-level slots, a conflicting 563-vs-464 protein count is adjudicated to the highest-ranked source, an author affiliation conflict is recorded rather than silently resolved, and omitted slots (total_size_bytes, collection_timeframes, last_updated_on) are each justified.

Complete and resolvable version lineage: four prior releases linked by typed is_new_version_of relationships each with its own DOI, enumerated in version_access, and backed by a named preservation commitment with institutional funding.

Rich, correctly typed external ecosystem integration: eleven external resources spanning domain-appropriate archival repositories (MassIVE for proteomics, SRA for sequence, Figshare), code, API documentation and publications, with embargo restrictions recorded rather than concealed.

Candid limitations and bias disclosure, including a scope_limitation admitting the release does not contain the project's headline cell-map product, typed bias categorization, and an explicit negative representativeness assessment with a stated reason.

Ethics and governance documented substantively for a non-human-subjects resource: a named Data Access Committee with a described review remit, two named ethics contacts with ORCIDs and emails, documented ethical sourcing of both cell lines including the HipSci MTA route, and anticipatory social impact analysis of downstream AI systems.

Explicit negative determinations used as documentation throughout - confidential, sensitive, content-warning and identifiable-element flags all set false with reasoning - so a reuser can distinguish an assessed 'no' from silence.
weaknesses: No software is named that produced or transformed the distributed data. The extensive named tooling is the cell-map pipeline whose outputs the record itself states are absent from this release, leaving the MS search stack, single-cell processing pipeline and any image processing behind the ten published archives entirely unstated.

The variables slot is absent entirely, with no data dictionary for any product - including the SEC-MS profiles and the Perturb-seq cell atlas that are distributed as processed_data and are inherently columnar.

Format declaration stops at the container: only ZIP and RO-Crate are declared, with no scientific payload format (mzML, FASTQ, TIFF, h5ad) and no character encoding, so a reuser cannot know what the archives contain until after download.

Version numbering regresses - this June 2026 release is recorded at 2.0 while version_access states the June 2025 and October 2025 releases were at 2.1 - which will mislead any consumer resolving latest-version by version string.
No change descriptions or errata: a reuser cannot determine what was added, revised or released from embargo relative to the October 2025 release this record supersedes.

Data quality reporting is thin where it matters most: anomalies and missing_data_documentation are both absent, and the single QC reference reports only that quality control was underway at an earlier time without stating any outcome.

The de-identification claim is asserted without assessing residual genomic re-identification risk, despite the release distributing raw CRISPRi sequence from a donor-derived line and disclosing donor attributes elsewhere in the record.
recommendations: Name the software and versions that produced each distributed product - the MS search and quantitation stack behind the AP-MS and SEC-MS archives, the single-cell pipeline behind the Perturb-seq cell atlas, and any image processing applied to the ICC-IF archives - and distinguish these in the record from the downstream cell-map pipeline whose outputs are not in this release.

Add variables entries with identifiers and descriptions for the tabular products, and declare per-collection payload formats, media types and character encoding alongside the ZIP container so reuse does not require downloading multi-gigabyte archives to discover their contents.

Reconcile the release version sequence and state which numbering authority the version slot reports, then add per-release change notes recording what was added, revised or released from embargo since the October 2025 release, together with any errata against prior releases.

Populate anomalies and missing_data_documentation per modality - failed or low-scoring antibodies in ICC-IF, low-confidence guide assignments and dropout in Perturb-seq, missing fractions in SEC-MS - and report the outcome of the single-cell QC that cleaning_strategies records as underway.

Add an explicit residual re-identification risk statement covering the genome-scale sequence products, referencing the terms under which the KOLF2.1J (HipSci) and MDA-MB-468 (ATCC) lines permit genotype-bearing data release, and state explicitly that no imputation was performed.

Populate download_url with the Dataverse Data Access API endpoint, name the repository in the publisher slot alongside the institutional ROR, and add a confidentiality_level classification so the regulatory position is machine-readable rather than only narrative.

Extend known_biases with a selection_bias entry covering the targeted protein-set selection and the non-overlapping protein coverage across modalities, and record annotation_analyses including the distribution of GSAI name-confidence scores.
